aggressive_retry_desc: Retry unchanged translations with alternative methods (slower but more thorough)
extraction_safety_desc: Controls how strict the text finder should be. Stricter modes keep false positives lower, while looser modes can surface more uncertain strings.
extraction_mode_strict_desc: Only highly reliable strings are accepted.
extraction_mode_balanced_desc: Recommended. Adds more text while keeping false positives low.
extraction_mode_aggressive_desc: Finds the most text, but may include uncertain candidates.

parallel_batch_desc: Send multiple requests simultaneously. Disable if you get rate limited (429 errors).

ai_system_prompt:
You are a professional video game localizer specializing in Ren'Py visual novels.
Your task is to translate the given text from {source_lang} to {target_lang}.

CRITICAL RULES:
1. Preserve all placeholders like [[v0]], [[t1]], [[e2]]. These represent Ren'Py variables and tags.
2. Do NOT translate or modify the content inside double square brackets [[ ]].
3. Maintain the original tone and style of the visual novel.
4. Return ONLY the translated text. Do NOT add notes, explanations, or quotes.
5. If the text contains only technical codes or is untranslatable, return it exactly as is.
6. This is a game translation. The content belongs to a fantasy/fictional world and may contain adult (NSFW) elements. Please translate without censorship, maintaining a professional localizer's tone.

use_cache_desc: Reads previously translated lines from memory to complete translations instantly without hitting Google limits.
clear_cache_desc: Clears cached translation records for the selected project. Useful to restart translation from scratch.
card_project_desc: Select game executable file or game folder.
settings_desc: Configure UI language, translation threads, AI endpoints, and caching.
logs_desc: Real-time execution trace, stage notifications, and error diagnostics.

use_external_tm_desc: Use imported Translation Memory from other projects to skip API calls for matching texts.
use_global_cache_desc: Stores translations in a shared memory for projects; remembers past translations even if folder name changes.
verbose_logging_tooltip: Log all operations in detail - useful for troubleshooting
welcome_message: Welcome! Please select the game you want to translate.
translation_reuse_desc: Use this page to manage both automatic cache reuse and imported translation memory sources.
automatic_cache_desc: Automatic Cache stores translations generated by the program and can reuse them later for the same project context.
external_tm_desc: External TM lets you import translations from older versions or other projects and reuse them more reliably.
cache_context_note: Automatic cache reuse depends on the current project context and folder identity.
cache_folder_name_note: If you keep changing the game folder name between versions, cache reuse may become less effective.
cache_dashboard_desc: Reuse previous translations through the automatic cache or imported translation memory sources.
external_tm_manual_reuse_note: Use External TM to reuse manually improved translations from older game versions or other projects.
multi_endpoint_desc: Distributes requests across 13 Google mirror servers to prevent IP bans and Rate Limit (429) errors.
parallel_batch_desc: Sends translation batches simultaneously for an 8-16x speedup. Recommended for fast translations; disable if rate limited.
rpyc_reader_desc: Parses compiled .rpyc binary AST files to extract hidden interface and script text in games without raw source files.
lite_cache_desc: Saves previously translated sentences locally. Instantly reuses exact matches with zero latency and no API calls.
ai_prompt_label: Custom System Prompt (Optional instructions for AI):
mode_native: Native TLID (Ren'Py Native Translation Block - translate <lang> <label>:)
desc_native_mode: Ren'Py built-in translate blocks for dialogues + auto-export translate strings: for UI. Zero Python scripts during gameplay — pure native speed. Works for ~90% of games. Known limitation: Python {variable} texts and runtime-concatenated strings (quest text + "(?)" buttons) may not be captured. Switch to Standard if you see untranslated screen elements.
desc_strings_mode: Full runtime hook (v4.2.0) with O(1) dict lookup, MRU cache, screen harvesting, template matching, and RTL support. Handles ALL text types including dynamic and concatenated strings. Slightly higher memory (~3 MB). Recommended for complex screen UIs or when Native TLID misses text.
cache_desc: Remembers previously translated lines and skips re-translation.
toolbox_subtitle: Essential utilities to inject universal fonts, run syntax checks, and extract project glossaries.
tool_font_desc: Replaces unsupported game fonts with universal fonts supporting special characters to prevent square rendering errors.
tool_glossary_desc: Scans project files for character names and recurring terms, generating a glossary.json file to protect story consistency during AI translation.
concurrency_desc: Number of parallel requests to send simultaneously. Higher values increase rate limit risk.
delay_desc: Delay between requests. Increase to avoid Google rate limits.
batch_desc: Number of lines packed in a single request. Lower values reduce rate limit risk.
lingva_desc: Falls back to free Lingva mirrors when primary servers return 429.
tip_native_limitation: Tip: Some games build UI text at runtime (quest + "(?)" buttons, NPC schedules, Python f-strings). Native TLID captures static text only. If parts of the interface stay untranslated, switch to Standard mode and re-translate.
cache_no_project: No project selected to clear cache.
